# `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data`

This directory contains pre-generated ICU4X baked data macros for Chromium,
analogous to `//third_party/icu`'s per-platform ICU4C `.dat` bundles. See
[go/icu4x-chromium-data-strategy](http://go/icu4x-chromium-data-strategy) for
the overall design and data strategy.

Because ICU4X's `BakedExporter` (with `use_separate_crates = false`) emits
`macro_rules!` definitions (`make_provider!` and `impl_<marker>!`) that are
expanded inside each downstream `icu_<component>` crate when `compiled_data` is
enabled, `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib` has zero crate dependencies in
`BUILD.gn` and unreferenced data markers incur zero compile-time or binary-size
cost.

## Directory Layout

- `BUILD.gn`: Defines `//third_party/rust/icu4x_data:lib`, selecting the target
  platform's data bundle via `--cfg=icu4x_data_platform_<platform>` (mirroring
  `//third_party/icu/BUILD.gn`, overridable via the `icu4x_override_data_dir`
  GN arg).
- `sources.gni`: Auto-generated lists of `.rs.data` and `mod.rs` inputs per
  platform for GN dependency tracking.
- `src/lib.rs`: Exports `cldr_tag!`, `unicode_tag!`, and `segmenter_lstm_tag!`
  and `include!`s `data/<platform>/mod.rs` at the crate root.

## Regenerating Data

The files in this directory are generated by
`//tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py` (which builds and runs
`//tools/crates/icu4x_datagen`):

```bash
python3 tools/crates/run_icu4x_datagen.py generate
```
